dependency_audit.font_catalog_locale: load_datum_fonts constructs one process OnceLock catalog/locale; measurement and renderer systems clone it. Production db_mut occurs only while installing the initial embedded sources. No public TextRun locale/font-reload/revision controls exist.
dependency_audit.shape_inputs: Plain text or exact rich span text, face, size, span bold/italic. Basic shaping, tab width 8 and process locale are fixed. Direction follows exact paragraph input. Rich colors remain live paint.
dependency_audit.layout_inputs: Physical width/height extent, size-derived 1.22 line height, WordOrGlyph wrapping and default alignment. Placement/clip/target/atlas dependencies remain in layout or GPU preparation as appropriate.
dependency_audit.boundary: This identifies current immutable authority and mutable inputs; it does not claim dynamic font reload, arbitrary shaping feature support or the original independent S5 dependency qualification.

limits: Earlier width payload completion did not include Datum allocation headers; this production correction repairs that omission and preserves its historical evidence. Measurement registry, private font/shaping scratch and native/RSS observations remain separate broader accounting boundaries.

Current-frame/source TextRun still owns any fallback string; only the retained shaping key removes its redundant copy. No claim that all GUI text allocations disappear or that measured frame latency improved.

No new predicate, S4/S5 or issue closure; sixteen recorded implementation gaps remain. Preserve original dependency qualification, GEFN, nonblocking resize and concurrent multi-device boundaries. No dependency, vendor, license, prototype, numerical specification cap or sequencing change.
